posts.content:
Another free backlink hack for your SaaS: get listed on Craft CMS Plugin Store (DR 80). Dofollow link to your site.

Here is how:
1. Sign up at https://console.craftcms.com/register
2. Connect GitHub, add plugin
3. Submit for approval

Craft plugins only.

https://t.co/ZMACg3SRnv

posts.notes: 在 Craft CMS Plugin Store 注册 console.craftcms.com、连接 GitHub 添加 plugin、提交 approval，得到 DR80 的 dofollow link。
